Xi Jinping Vows Military Strength and Anti-Corruption Drive

Chinese President Xi Jinping has pledged to strengthen the nation's military and intensify efforts to combat corruption. These commitments were made in a speech marking the 105th anniversary of the Chinese Communist Party. Xi also emphasized upholding the party's leadership over the armed forces.
